mutations.because: drawHtml must paint nothing, or the canonical image-html golden can change without a failing test. Painting #ff00fe at (0,0,2,2) before the return makes the top-left pixel that colour.
mutations.retired: Retired by AR7: drawHtml and the html layer kind it drew are gone (creative-templates.ts's canonical image-html now mirrors image-text's layers — image, shade, accent, static-text, logo — per D159, so there is no html-kind layer left for a golden to hold byte-identical). Its own test file, NodeCanvasCompositor.draw-html.test.ts, was deleted with it.
